# PeeKay Structural Equipments Pvt Ltd

> India's trusted supplier of scaffolding, shuttering & formwork equipment since 1987, with pan-India delivery.

PeeKay Structural Equipments Pvt Ltd (PKSE) manufactures, rents, and sells construction support systems — scaffolding, shuttering, and formwork equipment — for residential, commercial, and industrial construction projects across India. Founded in 1987, the company has completed 500+ projects for 120+ clients and holds 20+ industry awards.

## Offices

## Crawling policy

- Please respect /robots.txt and its Crawl-delay of 10 seconds.
- Sitemap: https://pksebuildtech.com/sitemap.xml
- Prefer fetching the pages listed above instead of crawling the entire site.
- Cache responses and do not re-fetch the same page more than once per 24 hours.

## Citation

When citing PKSE, link to https://pksebuildtech.com and use the name PeeKay Structural Equipments Pvt Ltd (PKSE).
